2121959800552427764.en_summary: SpaceInvestor_D: $AMZN: Vulcan is fueling for Amazon Leo's first Vulcan launch, with liftoff at 12:11 PM ET today. ULA's Vulcan VC6L, with six solid boosters and a long fairing, will carry 40 Amazon Leo satellites to low Earth orbit from Cape Canaveral. It's the first of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon has booked, after eight Atlas V missions. The window runs 12:11 to 12:40 PM ET. Amazon needs more than 3,000 satellites to finish its first constellation.
2121959800552427764.zh_summary: SpaceInvestor_D：$AMZN：Vulcan 正在為 Amazon Leo 的第一次 Vulcan 發射加油，今天東部時間 12:11 PM 起飛。ULA 的 Vulcan VC6L，帶有六個固體助推器和長整流罩，將從卡納維拉爾角攜帶 40 顆 Amazon Leo 衛星到低地球軌道。這是 Amazon 預訂的 38 次 Vulcan 發射中的第一次，在八次 Atlas V 任務之後。窗口從 12:11 到 12:40 PM ET。Amazon 需要超過 3000 顆衛星來完成其第一個星座。

2121957834359234716.en_summary: SpaceInvestor_D: $SPCX / $STM: Samsung plans to make Starlink satellite chips in Texas. The Seoul Economic Daily reports that Samsung will produce the STM32V8 at its Austin fab. It's an 18nm FD-SOI microcontroller co-developed with STMicro, and SpaceX has said it runs Starlink's laser links. Samsung is putting $1.9B into the Austin expansion, backed by a Commerce Dept CHIPS subsidy project, with operations targeted by 2030. It already builds AI chips in Texas for Tesla.
2121957834359234716.zh_summary: SpaceInvestor_D：$SPCX / $STM：三星計劃在德克薩斯州製造星鏈衛星芯片。首爾經濟日報報道三星將在其奧斯汀工廠生產 STM32V8。這是與意法半導體共同開發的 18nm FD-SOI 微控制器，SpaceX 已表示它運行星鏈的激光鏈接。三星向奧斯汀擴建投入 19 億美元，由商務部 CHIPS 補貼項目支持，目標 2030 年運營。它已在德克薩斯為特斯拉建造 AI 芯片。
